---
name: Proposal
about: Propose a bounded improvement to the research infrastructure
title: "[Proposal] "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## Problem or research outcome

Describe the concrete research, reproducibility, maintenance, or usability
problem.

## Proposed change

Define the smallest useful change.

## Owning surface

Identify which surface owns the change:

- contract
- corpus
- baseline
- schedule
- schema
- observations
- evidence/provenance
- analysis
- scholarly metadata
- tooling/CI
- governance/documentation

## Contract boundary

Explain why the change does not silently rewrite the frozen preregistration.

If it changes an operational rule, identify the required amendment or deviation.

## Evidence and alternatives

Separate repository facts from assumptions or preferences. Note reasonable
alternatives considered.

## Acceptance criteria

State observable criteria for completion.

## Non-goals and risks

State what this proposal intentionally does not change, including historical or
prospective research effects.
